newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Thursday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers-Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075 lbs 2 lds 63.50.
